qualityCriteria: Resolved failure or retained normal control requires execution-qualified published answer, independent source review, no material unsupported assertions, and complete/correct answer for positives or explicit correct insufficient-evidence handling for absence questions. Protocol/withheld/missing read-binding outcomes receive no credit.
reviewPolicy: Model-assisted source-based review, blinded to case ID and baseline/failure/control status; no gold or expected answers in generation or reviewer packets. Preserve answer/source/request hashes and every outcome.
limits: No population/general improvement rate inferred from a selected-failure cohort plus five controls. No default/model/vector changes. No paid provider calls or real profile access.
